title: SCNSim V1 identity documents
description: Canonical envelope schemas for the CONVERGING SCNSim V1 workspace protocol.

workspaceInstanceId.description: Evidence-only UUID for one concrete workspace binding.

f64.description: Finite IEEE-754 binary64 encoded as 16 lowercase big-endian hexadecimal digits.

componentPath.description: Nonempty root-to-child component ID segments; never a slash-joined path.

shape.description: [F,N,N]; the final two dimensions equal coordinate_ids length.

hbArtifactReference.description: Operation-specific HB receipt/outcome artifact reference. case_id and id are semantic; path locates bytes within this exact attempt; sha256 proves those bytes.

values_f64.description: Row-major finite coherent-SI values; cardinality is checked semantically against shape.

prefixItems.const: C Units:pF/meter, G Units:mho/meter, R Units:ohm/meter, L Units:nH/meter

bootstrapReady.description: Blocked-child protocol frame; never request or outcome authority.

launchAuthorization.description: Python frame authorizing the blocked child only after attempt.json is sealed.
